name: io.github.ghorbelhamdi/buddy-phone-bridge
title: Buddy phone tools
description: Android phone tools for AI agents (read the screen, tap, type, open apps), served by the Buddy app.

environmentVariables.name: BUDDY_URL
environmentVariables.description: On a computer: the phone's Tailscale address, e.g. http://100.x.y.z:8765 (Buddy's Settings > Phone tools in your own sessions > Phone tools on Tailscale shows it). The first tool call asks you on the phone to pair this computer. Leave empty on the phone itself (Termux).

environmentVariables.name: BUDDY_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional: a token from Buddy's Settings instead of pairing (needed on the phone itself, e.g. in Termux)
